worldcombat.skill.spotlight.summary: Pin a beam of light on the foe: while lit it takes more damage from every source and becomes the centre of attention - creatures on your side are pointed at it. The light has a time limit.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.use.1: Expose it before the team opens up
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.use.2: Pull a nearby pack onto one target
The lit foe takes %1$s%% more damage from all sources for %2$s s.
Cast reach is about %1$s blocks with a sweep of about %2$s blocks.
Preparation %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s from cast.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.stance.pierc: Pierce: exposure x1.4 but the light lasts only 70%% as long - make an opening and strike while it is bright.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.stance.pin: Pin: exposure x0.75 but the light lasts 1.3x as long - hold the foe in the spotlight.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.timing: Cast on a foe. After %2$s s of preparation it spends %4$s PP, recovers %3$s s, and commits a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.preference.m: Pierce: exposure x1.4, light x0.7, made for opening a target before focus fire. Pin: exposure x0.75, light x1.3, made to hold a foe in the spotlight. Strength and duration trade off.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.preference.a: Only shine on a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher marks a target from farther away.
Only prioritise the spotlight once this many allies (including yourself) are gathered near the target; 1 shines on sight, higher only when focus fire is real.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to shine the light.
